subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Hand washing routine and rhymes; health check

show.line: Wash, wash, wash your hands! Water, soap, rub and rinse. Germs go away!

rounds.prompt: What do we use to wash our hands?
rounds.praise: Soap! Soap and water wash germs away.

rounds.prompt: When must we wash our hands? Tap the picture.
rounds.praise: Yes! Always wash after the toilet.

rounds.prompt: We wash our hands before we eat. Say it with me. Wash before we eat!
Wash your hands now, or not needed? Sort them.

hints: Germs are tiny. We cannot see them, but soap chases them away.
Think: did my hands touch something dirty?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will wash my hands.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I just use water. No soap!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I need soap too. Water and soap!
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: We need soap and water. Rub, rub, rinse!

parent_line: Knows when and how to wash hands with soap and water.
